# QATS backtest study - generated by tools/qats_backtest.py

> **Regenerated on 2026-11-11 after a loader fix — every figure below comes from the re-run.**
> The public dataset ships one file per year and the files **overlap at their seams**: 8,127
> one-minute rows (0.23% of the history, up to 23 hours at each of eight 1 September boundaries)
> appear in two files. The first publication of this study (commit `43f08de`) fed those rows twice,
> which sent the simulated clock backwards at every seam. The loader now skips a row that does not
> move time forward (`tools/qats_sim/qats_driver.inc`; `tools/test_qats_dual_direction.py` section 4b
> proves that a market cut into two overlapping files replays exactly like the same market in one
> file), and the whole matrix and the mirror proof were run again.
>
> What changed against the first publication:
>
> * Of the 22 runs, 3 show the same trades, profit factor and expectancy (the in-sample account-level
>   runs, which stop trading in 2017) and 17 moved by **at most 4 trades each**, profit factor by
>   at most 0.009, expectancy by at most 0.005 R. Example, v1.20 BALANCED: in-sample
>   2,137 → 2,140 trades, PF 0.79 → 0.79, −0.126 → −0.127 R; out-of-sample 963 → 964 trades,
>   PF 1.00 → 1.00, +0.007 → +0.006 R.
> * Two account-level runs **start exactly on the 2023-09-01 seam** and end within weeks at the
>   drawdown halt, so the repeated hours changed their short path: v1.11 compiled defaults
>   50 → 30 trades (end balance 9,458.96 → 9,662.11), v1.20 compiled defaults 22 → 23 trades
>   (9,368.76 → 9,319.03). Both still end at the halt.
> * The direction-symmetry proof on 2019 gives the same table to the cent (191 / 123 ↔ 123 / 191,
>   776,525.58 on both feeds, 0 of 70,859 bars differ). One BUY of 2019-09-02, the first session
>   after a seam, now plans a nearer target; it was stopped out either way, so no result changes
>   (average planned R:R of the BUY side 3.25 → 3.21).
>
> The verdict is unchanged: **no demonstrated edge**.

**Simulation, not the MT5 Strategy Tester and not broker execution.** The EA source is built by
the host compiler against the typed MQL5 shim and replayed against `tools/qats_sim/`. Fill model:
four quotes per M1 bar, server-side stops fill at their level (at the quote on a gap), 5 points of
adverse slippage on every stop-loss fill, no commission, no swap. Server clock = New-York-close
(UTC+2 / UTC+3), the operator's broker convention. Symbol: 2 digits, 100 oz contract, min lot 0.01.

Dataset: `Dypoi/XAUUSD_Dataset` @ `4f9fe4b7a9fd` (M1 bid+ask, UTC, 2016-09-01 .. 2026-09-01; first 5 months are warm-up).
The dataset ships one file per year and the files overlap at their seams. A row that does not move
time forward is skipped, so no minute is replayed twice: 8,127 rows over the whole history
(`tools/test_qats_dual_direction.py` section 4b pins this).

| window | from | to | role |
|---|---|---|---|
| IS | 2017-02-01 | 2023-09-01 | in-sample |
| OOS | 2023-09-01 | 2026-09-01 | out-of-sample |

"Signal study" rows switch off ONLY the two breakers that end a run (equity drawdown halt, daily
loss lock) and use a 1,000,000 balance so the minimum lot never decides; every other guard is on.
They measure the SIGNAL over the whole window. "ALL guards on" rows are what an account would
have lived through: the compiled default inputs, or `presets/Quantum_XAUUSD_PRODUCTION.set`, on a 10,000 account.
The equity drawdown halt is a latch - once it trips, the EA sends nothing until an operator resets
it - so those rows END at the halt; the table "Account-level runs" gives the date.

The out-of-sample window was not used while the engine was designed. Nothing in this report is a
forecast: a simulation on one-minute bars cannot reproduce a broker's ticks, slippage or costs.

## Direction symmetry on real data

The same year of real prices is replayed twice: as recorded, and mirrored (price -> K - price, bid
and ask swapped, on an integer price grid so that both runs round identically). An engine that
treats the two directions alike must turn every BUY of the first run into a SELL of the second,
with the same volume and the same profit, and finish on the same balance.

| build | exact mirror | BUY / SELL trades | BUY / SELL trades, mirrored feed | end balance | end balance, mirrored feed | bars compared | bars that differ | trades that differ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1.20 | **YES** | 191 / 123 | 123 / 191 | 776525.58 | 776525.58 | 70859 | 0 | 0 |
| v1.11 | **NO** | 533 / 357 | 398 / 495 | 452450.62 | 472751.26 | n/a | n/a | n/a |

"Bars compared" = every analysed M5 bar: the BUY score of the first run must equal the SELL score of
the second, with mirrored evidence and the same outcome. v1.11 prints one score per bar, so only its
totals can be compared - and they do not mirror.

## How to reproduce

```
python3 tools/qats_backtest.py fetch --dest /path/to/xau_m1
python3 tools/qats_backtest.py study --data /path/to/xau_m1 --out out/qats_backtest
python3 tools/qats_backtest.py mirror --data /path/to/xau_m1 --from 2019-01-01 --to 2020-01-01 --baseline --out out/qats_backtest
python3 tools/qats_backtest.py report --dir out/qats_backtest
```
